root_cause: The locator 'loginEmail' is not defined in the Page Object Model's internal locator resolution map, causing the _resolveLocator method to return null.
impact: All test cases requiring user authentication fail immediately upon attempting to fill the email field.
suggested_fix: Add the 'loginEmail' locator to the constructor of the Page Object class.
recommendation: Verify that the CSS selector 'input[data-qa="login-email"]' matches the current DOM structure of the Automation Exercise login page.
